faqs.q: What should I include on a sealcoating invoice?
faqs.a: Your business details and license number, the job-site address (not just the billing address), and a line for each service with the measured quantity: sealcoat in square feet (noting two coats), crack filling in linear feet, patching, oil-spot priming, and striping. Note the product used (coal tar or asphalt emulsion), the cure window in the notes, tax, and the total. Crews that leave a paper invoice at the door get paid weeks faster than ones that mail it.

faqs.q: How much should I charge for driveway sealing?
faqs.a: Sealcoating runs $0.15–$0.30 per square foot for a two-coat application — a typical 600 sq ft driveway bills $150–$250. Crack filling adds $0.50–$1.50 per linear foot, pothole patching $2–$5 per square foot, and parking-lot striping $0.20–$0.40 per linear foot. Most crews enforce a $150–$250 minimum job charge to cover truck, tank, and drive time.

faqs.q: Should I bill by measured square feet or by the estimate?
faqs.a: Bill what you actually measured. Walk the driveway, multiply length × width for each section, and put the measured number on the invoice. Customers dispute round-number guesses ('he said 800, invoiced 1,100') but rarely dispute a tape-measure figure. If the measurement grew from the phone quote, a line showing 'measured 1,050 sq ft' explains the difference before they call.

faqs.q: How do I price crack filling and patching on the same invoice?
faqs.a: Keep them as separate lines, never bundled into the per-foot sealcoat price. Crack filling is priced per linear foot after routing and cleaning the cracks — $0.50–$1.50/lf covers hot rubber and the melter's fuel. Patching goes per square foot of repaired area. When every fix is its own visible line, the homeowner can see exactly what the extra $180 bought, and you stop giving away repair work inside a flat seal price.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate tax automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantity and rate per line, and the subtotal, tax and total update automatically. Leave the tax rate blank if paving services are not taxable in your state.
